summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh GitHub releases page into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line `// @bun @bun-cjs` blob with a custom string-array rotator (WV8StW), a large mixed numeric/string constant table, and hex-named identifiers — heavily obfuscated code with no accompanying native source or build step. The payload is unreferenced by the library's advertised `src/` and `dist/` React IoC (Inversify-based) sources, and fetching an alternate JavaScript runtime is unrelated to the manifest's stated purpose ("Implementation of InversifyJS for React applications using Context API"). Execution occurs automatically on `npm install`, before any consumer code runs, and delivers opaque attacker-controlled code onto the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
